critical_code_review_comments: recovery-suite.tsx & compass.tsx & mosaic.tsx are >200 lines each but still well-scoped; consider extracting shared Section/Row primitives to src/components.

compass.tsx offline branch swallows all API errors silently — if user has never loaded /compass online, cached pack is undefined and UI shows only spinner. Not a bug for smoke user (has cache) but worth a fallback msg.
api.ts throws generic Error with '<status>: <body>' — Paywall.tsx must parse this string to distinguish 402/409; brittle. Consider typed ApiError { status, code, message }.
